_doc: Static, code-fixed universe reliability constants for the v1 cross-sectional LSTM ranker. NOT recomputed per report — surfaced verbatim in every FactSet (Epic #1998, RPT-1 #2000). The method is described by `split` and `leakage_caveat` below; read those as the ground truth. See ADR-CARD-01 for why this field no longer describes the method itself.
leakage_caveat: v1 uses a random 80/20 train/test split; the true point-in-time train cutoff is unknown, so the score may be optimistically biased. Reliability is cross-sectional only (no per-symbol hit-rate). Net-of-cost (10 bps, daily rebalancing) the top-quintile Sharpe (0.758) falls BELOW EqualWeight (0.944).
provenance: NOT REPRODUCIBLE FROM THIS REPOSITORY. These numbers come from a session artifact that was never committed: the source files this field used to name exist neither in the working tree nor in any commit in the repo's history (ADR-CARD-01, verified). They can therefore be neither regenerated nor independently checked here. Treat them as unverified until a re-run under core/ml/validation/harness.py replaces them. Report-only, dormant: SPECIALIST_ALPHA_WEIGHT stays 0.
